title: Uniqueness of the matching partner
statement: Let $q,k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $M$ be a perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part. If a vertex $w$ is adjacent to a vertex $v$ in $M$, then $w$ is the matching partner of $v$.
